Name: Cheat Recipes
Author: exarobibliologist
Description:
There's no way to describe this other than to put the words cheat in all caps.

[size=5]THIS IS A CHEAT MOD!![/size]

[size=6]Please use [u]responsibly[/u]... or [i][u]not[/u][/i]![/size]

It adds recipes so that you can convert low-tier ores and materials into higher-tier ones, and vice-versa. You can upcycle Wood into lots of more valuable stuff!

The conversion for most things is 1:2
Wood (or Stone) -> Copper -> Iron -> Gold -> Iridium -> Radioactive -> Cinder Shards (or Prismatic Gems)

Sustenance Creation
1 Wood or Stone -> 10 Spicy Eel
1 Wood or Stone -> 10 Triple Shot Espresso
100 Wood or Stone -> 100 Magic Rock Candy

Bar upcycling - The conversion rate for most things is 1:2

Cinder Shard Crafting - Conversion rates differ here. Might sound extreme, but trust me it's not. If you use the mod you can easily end up with a tremendous amount of Cinder Shards!
1 CS -> Geode
2 CS -> Frozen Geode
3 CS -> Magma Geode
4 CS -> Omni Geode
5 CS -> Artifact Trove
10 CS -> Prize Ticket
15 CS -> Golden Walnut
15 CS -> Qi Gem
30 CS -> Treasure Chest
30 CS -> Dinosaur Egg
500 CS -> Stardrop [b][i](SAY WHAT!?!? Yes, you can [u]craft [/u]a [u]Stardrop[/u]... Good deal? That's for you to decide.)[/i][/b]
